scope: Five frozen 3.44 cards only; no new source acquisition, production edits, upload or browser use.

findings.before: Tax/punishment summary generalized rebellion/amputation, omitting repeated attempts and right-hand qualification.
findings.after: Candidate author tightened both Chinese and English summary to preserve those qualifications; exact saved text and current catalog reread.

semanticChecks.basis: Travel report clearly separated from a formal law code; adjacent punishment passages read together. Gupta phase is chronological/geographic reading context, not a named empire-wide survey; P/null observation dates retained.

Chinese iron deeds and English broader metal plates are explicitly distinguished. Describes recorded endowments in the account, not acquired surviving original deeds or a dynasty-wide dated land grant.
Oral transmission, manuscript acquisition and the narrated three-year study/transcription interval match chapter 36. Duration is not converted into specific years or a general literacy indicator.

Market divisions, adjudicators and measure inspection are directly locatable. Comparative relation avoids inferring professional/full-time judges. Claimed crowd and Spanish comparisons are not imported as population or territorial observations.

The passage supports paper records and its descriptive terms. Mnemonic/nonwritten P and written A remain exact original coding; the card asks a classification comparison and does not rewrite the source value.

editionChecks.faxian: UCSD Jordan teaching revision of Legge 1886, not an unchanged 1886 transcription; mechanical simplified Chinese is documented.
editionChecks.cortes: Thatcher 1907 anthology selection and Arkenberg modernization; no invented individual translator or substitution of MacNutt 1908.

limits: Reviewed acquired source text and selected byte anchors; did not independently establish workbook bibliography lineage.
No claim of a complete Gupta or Aztec history; only these five selected readings and eight exact existing rows were checked.
Offline full-document extraction has separate source-agent coverage tests; this review checks semantic claims and cited original rows/anchors.
